commands.name: canceldemo
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { for (let i = 0; i < 400; i += 1) { if (ctx.signal.aborted) { return; } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); } }

commands.name: outputdemo
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { ctx.out.write('a'); ctx.out.write('b'); ctx.out.write({ nested: { ok: true }, values: [1, 2] }); ctx.out.write({ nested: { ok: true }, values: [1, 2] }, { pretty: false }); ctx.out.info({ l10n: { 'en-US': 'Hello', 'fr': 'Bonjour' }, data: { n: 1 } }); return 42; }

commands.name: helpapi
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { if (!argv.positionals[0]) { ctx.help('Missing required target.', { level: 'error' }); } return argv.positionals[0]; }

en-US.title: helpapi
en-US.summary: Shows ctx.help() from inside main() when the target argument is missing.
